newsitem.title: USA: Precision Castparts stake cut by Gabelli.
newsitem.headline: Precision Castparts stake cut by Gabelli.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it cut its stake in Precision Castparts Corp to 1,013,300 common shares or 4.92 percent from 6.09 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 185,200 common shares sold between January 9 and January 21 at prices ranging from $51 to $57.375 per share.

The Portland, Or., based company manufactures, to customer specifications, large and complex structural investment castings and other investment castings from steel and alloys of nickel, cobalt and titanium.
